hero.title: Tailored solutions for your vehicles and energy needs
hero.subtitle: NJIWA helps you import quality used vehicles, install solar energy systems, track your fleet with GPS, and monitor fuel consumption. Reliable services, designed for Africa.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: A trusted partner at your service
about.description: NJIWA is a company specializing in the importation of quality used vehicles and in technology-driven solutions for transport and energy. We leverage our expertise to serve individuals, businesses, and institutions with reliable products at competitive prices.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: To deliver carefully selected used vehicles alongside innovative energy and technology solutions that meet our clients' real-world needs — backed by impeccable service and personalized support at every step.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: To become Central Africa's leading provider of used vehicle imports and integrated solutions in solar energy, fleet tracking, and fuel management — with customer satisfaction at the heart of every decision.

values.title: Reliability
values.description: Every vehicle is inspected and every system is tested to guarantee uncompromising quality for our clients.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: We communicate openly about pricing, timelines, and the condition of every product or service we offer.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We adopt the latest technologies to deliver high-performance solutions tailored to the local context.

values.title: Customer commitment
values.description: Your satisfaction is our priority. We support you before, during, and after every project.

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Complete solutions for your vehicles and energy needs

items.title: Used Vehicle Import
items.description: We import carefully selected used vehicles from Japan, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Europe. Every vehicle undergoes a thorough mechanical inspection before shipping so you can buy with complete confidence.
features: Vehicles inspected and certified before shipping
Wide selection: sedans, SUVs, pickups, vans, and trucks
Imports from Japan, the USA, London, and Europe
Full support: selection, transit, customs clearance, and delivery
Competitive pricing and flexible payment terms

items.title: Solar Energy Systems
items.description: We design and install custom solar systems for homes, businesses, and remote sites. Reduce your dependence on the power grid and take control of your energy costs with clean, renewable power.
features: Technical assessment and custom system sizing
High-performance solar panels and certified inverters
Residential, commercial, and industrial solutions
Off-grid or hybrid systems with battery storage
Preventive maintenance and post-installation technical support

items.title: GPS Vehicle Tracking
items.description: Take full control of your fleet with our real-time geolocation systems. Our GPS technology lets you track your vehicles, optimize routes, and strengthen the security of your assets.
features: Real-time location on an interactive map
Detailed trip and stop history
Configurable alerts: speeding, geofencing, unauthorized ignition
Dashboard accessible from computer and smartphone
Discreet installation compatible with all vehicle types

items.title: Fuel Monitoring & Management
items.description: Eliminate fuel losses and optimize consumption with our advanced monitoring solutions. Our high-precision sensors detect anomalies in real time — whether on your vehicles or stationary storage tanks.
features: High-precision fuel level sensors
Instant detection of theft and leaks
Monitoring for stationary tanks and vehicle fuel systems
Detailed consumption reports and automatic alerts
Integration with GPS systems for unified fleet management

items.title: Drilling boreholes
items.description: We drill water boreholes for different objectives in diverse environments. We conduct in-depth studies to deliver high-quality wells precisely suited to your needs. We strictly observe safety, hygiene, and environmental standards to your complete satisfaction — serving both community spaces and industry. Water quality analysis can be provided on request.
features: In-depth studies for high-quality borehole drilling
Compliance with safety, hygiene and environmental standards
Operations in community and industrial environments
Water quality analysis available on request
Multi-environment expertise: domestic, industrial and agricultural water

items.title: Environmental tasks
items.description: This century of intense industrialization brings numerous activities that can destroy the environment and disrupt ecosystem balance. We conduct thorough studies of your production activities to propose operating procedures that minimize environmental impact according to universally accepted standards. We implement adequate solutions while guaranteeing clean production. In summary, we take charge from design through to the evacuation of all types of waste.
features: Environmental impact studies for your production activities
Tailored operating procedures to minimize ecological impact
Solutions compliant with universally accepted environmental standards
Complete waste management: from design to disposal
Ensuring clean and sustainable production

gpsAbroad.title: GPS Tracking Abroad
gpsAbroad.subtitle: Our GPS trackers work in real-time across multiple African countries: Tanzania, Zambia and DRC
